<documents>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="atm-surcharges">
ATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆandˆourˆfeesˆWhenˆyouˆuseˆanˆATMˆoutsideˆBrookLink,ˆupˆtoˆtwoˆdifferentˆchargesˆcanˆapply.ˆThey'reˆeasyˆtoˆmixˆup.ˆ##ˆTheˆATMˆowner'sˆsurchargeˆThisˆisˆsetˆbyˆwhoeverˆownsˆtheˆATM,ˆnotˆbyˆus.ˆTheˆATMˆshowsˆitˆonˆscreenˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm,ˆandˆit'sˆaddedˆtoˆtheˆwithdrawalˆamount.ˆForˆexample,ˆifˆyouˆwithdrawˆcashˆandˆtheˆownerˆchargesˆaˆsurcharge,ˆoneˆtransactionˆforˆtheˆtotalˆappearsˆinˆyourˆactivity.ˆ##ˆTallowbrook'sˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆThisˆisˆourˆfee,ˆchargedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆcalledˆ"Out-of-networkˆATMˆfee".ˆIt'sˆ$2.50ˆonˆBasicˆandˆonˆPlusˆafterˆyourˆfreeˆwithdrawals,ˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆsurchargeˆreimbursementˆPremiumˆpaysˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆperˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆcreditedˆautomaticallyˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth.ˆ##ˆAvoidingˆbothˆUseˆaˆBrookLinkˆATM.ˆTheyˆneverˆchargeˆaˆsurcharge,ˆandˆweˆneverˆchargeˆaˆfeeˆforˆthem.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="atm-abroad">
UsingˆATMsˆabroadˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆworksˆatˆATMsˆabroadˆthatˆacceptˆVisa.ˆ##ˆWhatˆitˆcostsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆfeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆTheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆreplacesˆtheˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆforˆwithdrawalsˆoutsideˆtheˆUS.ˆTheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawals.ˆItˆonlyˆappliesˆtoˆpurchases.ˆTheˆATMˆownerˆmayˆaddˆitsˆownˆsurcharge.ˆPremiumˆsurchargeˆreimbursementˆcoversˆATMsˆabroadˆtoo,ˆupˆtoˆtheˆsameˆmonthlyˆcap.ˆ##ˆPickˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆIfˆtheˆATMˆoffersˆtoˆconvertˆtheˆwithdrawalˆintoˆUSˆdollarsˆforˆyou,ˆdeclineˆandˆchooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆTheˆATM'sˆrateˆisˆusuallyˆworseˆthanˆtheˆnetworkˆrate.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆWithdrawalsˆabroadˆcountˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆdailyˆATMˆlimitˆasˆwithdrawalsˆatˆhome.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆATMˆkeepsˆyourˆcardˆFreezeˆtheˆcardˆinˆtheˆappˆstraightˆawayˆandˆreportˆitˆlost.ˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆaskˆforˆanˆemergencyˆcardˆabroad.ˆEveryoneˆelseˆcanˆuseˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆaˆmobileˆwalletˆuntilˆthey'reˆhome.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
